Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production character turnaround for the Rail Arena 3D modeling reference pack.
Use the attached APPROVED CONCEPT as the design authority. Match the polished low-poly, high-detail game art quality of that image, NOT a crude geometric mannequin. Preserve this specific character's identity, face, hair, armor silhouette, colors, accessories and layered tailoring. Adult athletic anatomy, roughly 7.5 heads tall, expressive anatomically sculpted face, sophisticated overlapping polygonal hair locks, crisp beveled armor, articulated dark fabric joints, finely finished gloves and athletic boots. No redesign.
Create ONE very high-resolution landscape contact sheet with EXACTLY EIGHT equal-sized, fully visible head-to-sole orthographic turnaround views of ONE AND THE SAME character in a 4 column x 2 row grid. Stable relaxed A pose: arms 25 degrees away from torso, fingers separated naturally, legs straight, parallel feet, no contrapposto. The body, equipment and pose are a single locked object rotated in place, never redrawn as different costume variants. Same body scale, head height and soles baseline within each row, same neutral soft studio lighting. Character fills each cell with clear silhouette and modest gutters, light warm gray background, no perspective or foreshortening in cardinal views, no dramatic shadows.
Top row: FRONT; FRONT-RIGHT 45; RIGHT PROFILE; BACK-RIGHT 45.
Bottom row: BACK; BACK-LEFT 45; LEFT PROFILE; FRONT-LEFT 45.
RIGHT and LEFT mean the CHARACTER'S anatomical sides, not image sides. In RIGHT PROFILE the nose points to the RIGHT edge of the sheet; LEFT PROFILE nose points LEFT. Back views show the back, never duplicated fronts. Hair silhouette, glove cuffs, armor seams, knee guards, boots, belt pouches, cloth split panels must agree spatially in all eight rotations. Label each cell with exactly the corresponding view text, plus a small restrained character title. No cropped feet, no weapons, no bonus characters, no new cybernetic parts, no numbered measurements, no floating accessories, no invented text paragraphs. Treat this as a careful multi-view reconstruction of the approved character.

designs.Player: Character title: PLAYER. Select ONLY the first male ivory-and-cyan player from the attached approved sheet and the player details in its lower half. Warm medium-light tan skin, angular youthful adult male face, dark eyes, thick stern brows, dark brown swept spiky layered hair, strong tapered jaw, clean shaven. Teal folded scarf wraps the neck with short layered front V folds and a thick rear cowl, no long tail. Ivory/champagne beveled shoulder shells and shaped ivory chest plate over charcoal segmented suit, small restrained cyan inset strips at shoulders/chest/wrists/knees/ankles, gray metal buckles. Two matching mid-thigh dark cloth panels bordered with broad ivory strips, dark trouser thighs and shins with ivory angular knee guards and small shin armor. Compact dark belt pouches at both sides, central rectangular gray buckle. Black fingerless gloves, ivory armored forearm bracers, fitted dark athletic armored boots with ivory toe/heel/ankle shell pieces. Back: use the existing player BACK inset as authority: compact ivory scapular/back plate with small cyan marks, teal rear cowl, dark spine below, no backpack, no cape. Balanced bilateral armor; do not introduce a diagonal chest sash.
designs.Bot01: Character title: BOT 01. Select ONLY the second character, the terracotta-and-amber athletic adult WOMAN. Warm medium tan skin, slim angular female face, dark eyes, stern brows, dark brown-black hair gathered into a high compact swept bun with asymmetric forehead locks and short face-framing strands; maintain her recognizable feminine facial anatomy without glamor makeup. Charcoal close-fitting neck guard/scarf with amber rim, terracotta/rust orange beveled shoulders and fitted continuous segmented chest armor, amber/gold slim trim at upper arms, wrist cuffs, outer thigh panels, angular knees and boot edges. Charcoal articulated undersuit with black trouser legs. Terracotta paired split thigh-length cloth/armor tabs, a rectangular compact dark utility holster/pouch mounted on HER RIGHT outer upper thigh (viewer LEFT in front view); keep that exact anatomical side in all angles. Small dark belt pouches, dark belt and central brass rectangular buckle. Rust armored bracers, black fingerless gloves, dark fitted boots with rust guards and amber trim. Front chest is rust plates with small dark seams, no large glowing V symbol. Back is a restrained matching terracotta upper-back plate on dark fitted suit, amber seam accents, compact bun above dark collar; no backpack or cape, no long scarf tails. Rear details are a consistent continuation of the approved front design, not a new outfit.
designs.Bot02: Character title: BOT 02. Select ONLY the third character, the pale-haired teal/slate male. Fair warm skin, angular adult male face with strong jaw, dark eyes and stern brows, pale platinum blond swept layered spiky hair with cream shadows, clean shaven. Dark teal folded scarf/cowl. Slate/teal shaped chest shell with IVORY/SILVER shoulder armor, IVORY/SILVER clavicle reinforcement plates framing the upper chest, IVORY/SILVER forearm bracers, IVORY/SILVER angular knee shells. Dark teal/slate mid-thigh split coat panels with pale borders over charcoal and dark-teal suit, black articulated joints. Dark belt, central gray rectangular buckle, paired compact dark side pouches. Black fingerless gloves, fitted black armored athletic boots with pale toe/heel shells and small teal accents. Restrained cyan/teal narrow accents, never bright red/amber. Back continues the pale shoulder/yoke reinforcement, slate upper-back panel, teal rear scarf, dark spine with small teal inset, no backpack/cape/long scarf tail. Same costume throughout, not a recolor of the ivory player.
designs.Bot03: Character title: BOT 03. Select ONLY the fourth character, the dark-skinned plum/copper athletic adult WOMAN. Deep warm brown skin, sharply defined adult feminine face, dark brown eyes, strong brows, full natural lips, sculpted cheekbones. Thick charcoal-black locs sweep predominantly over HER RIGHT temple (viewer LEFT in front view), HER LEFT temple is closely cropped with neat parallel shaved rows; maintain this asymmetry and the same loc lengths in every view. Plum/aubergine layered shoulder and chest armor over charcoal fitted suit, small warm copper/brass hardware, edging and wrist guards, compact dark high collar, no teal scarf. Dark belt, copper central rectangular buckle and side utility pouches. Split asymmetric plum thigh panels: HER LEFT outer thigh has a short angular copper-edged plum flap, HER RIGHT has the longer vertical plum panel. Keep these anatomical sides fixed. Plum angular knee guards and fitted dark boots with plum shell pieces and copper toe/heel trim, black fingerless gloves. Compact dark shoulder harness with copper fasteners, but NO large diagonal copper stripe across the chest, no glowing orange V. Back: restrained plum upper-back plates and dark harness, matching asymmetric locs and thigh flaps, no backpack, cape, new insignia or long tail. Preserve the approved woman's identity, not a male body with a female hairstyle.
